_comment_claudeConfigDir: Optional. Point at a specific Claude config dir to isolate the customer license from a personal account (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR setups). Default: ~/.claude
_comment_expectedOrgUuid: Optional local guard. If set, the collector only pushes when the current Claude org matches this uuid.
_comment_vpn: VPN gate. While a VPN is detected the collector sends NOTHING (not even a DNS lookup) — the day is queued locally and sent on the next run off VPN. Run 'node vpn.js' to see the current verdict.
_comment_skipOnVpn: Master switch for the VPN gate. Turning this off means reports may be sent from inside a customer network. Do not set it to false without a decision to that effect.
_comment_treatProxyAsVpn: A machine-wide proxy is treated as a VPN, because it means traffic leaves through something we cannot account for. Set false only if our OWN network uses a proxy and this is suppressing reports everywhere.
_comment_vpnAllowInterfaces: macOS/Linux only. Exact network interface names to ignore when looking for tunnels, for a reviewed exception. Every name added here is a way for reports to leave over that interface.
_comment_vpnUnverified: If a VPN check cannot be run at all (blocked by policy), the collector now sends anyway, marked 'unverified' in the audit trail — it no longer stays silent forever with no way to notice. There is no setting for this; it is the default behavior.
